title: Split the Bill
subtitle: Record what the group spent, and Kancara works out who should pay whom so everyone is even.

save.failed: Your latest change is not saved yet. Check your internet connection, then try again.
save.conflict: Changed on another device. Reload to see the latest (your last change here will be lost).
save.waitingOffline: Offline. Changes to this bill are kept on this phone and sent automatically once you're back online.

newBill.title: Start a new bill?
newBill.body: All members, expenses, and paid marks on this bill will be deleted.
newBill.failed: The bill could not be deleted. Check your internet connection, then try again.

notice.legacyMoved: The bill kept on this device has been moved to your account.
notice.copyFailed: This browser does not allow copying. Try downloading the image instead.
notice.downloadFailed: The bill image could not be made. Try again in a moment.

members.heading: Who is chipping in?
members.hint: Add everyone who paid for something or shared in an expense.
members.full: A bill can have at most {count} members.
members.empty: Type the name of everyone chipping in, then choose Add. You can also pick from your saved profiles.

removeBody.one: {count} expense paid by {name} will also be removed from this bill.
removeBody.other: {count} expenses paid by {name} will also be removed from this bill.

picker.title: Saved member profiles
picker.intro: Choose who is chipping in this time.
picker.emptyHint: Save profiles of your family or travel friends to reuse them on later trips and bills.

expenses.heading: Record an expense
expenses.descriptionMissing: Say what this expense was for.
expenses.baseHint: You can do sums, like 3*45,000, then press Enter.
expenses.taxHint: An amount, or a percentage like 11%.
expenses.extraHint: Such as delivery or an admin fee.
expenses.invalidAmount: This number cannot be worked out. Check the signs and thousand separators.
expenses.sharedByHint: If nobody is selected, the expense is split equally among all members.
expenses.full: A bill can have at most {count} expenses.
expenses.empty: The expenses you record show up here, along with who paid for each.
expenses.removeBody: This expense will be removed from the bill and the totals.

results.heading: Split results
results.subtitle: Each person's share, and the fewest transfers that make everyone even.
results.breakdownSubtitle: Choose a name to see their share of each expense.
results.noLines: Did not share in any expense.
results.transfersSubtitle: Mark a transfer as settled once the money has arrived.
results.reminder: Hi {debtor}, a reminder from our trip's shared costs: please transfer {amount} to {creditor}. Thank you!
results.allEvenBody: Everyone paid exactly their share, so nobody needs to transfer anything.
